## `site_units`

Per-unit GEM records for sites in this country.

### Column legend

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `unit_id` | Primary key for the unit row. |
| `site_id` | Parent site UUID (`sites.site_id`). |
| `gem_unit_phase_id` | GEM unit-phase identifier for this row. |
| `unit_name` | GEM unit label within the location. |
| `capacity_mw` | Unit nameplate capacity (MW). |
| `status` | Unit lifecycle status enum. |
| `start_year` | Unit commercial operation start year. |
| `retired_year` | Unit retirement year when applicable. |
| `planned_retirement` | Column from live Postgres; see `src/atoms_vs_ashes/db/models.py` and `architecture/specs/02_data_model_postgres.md` for field semantics. |
| `combustion_technology` | Unit technology class. |
| `coal_type` | Column from live Postgres; see `src/atoms_vs_ashes/db/models.py` and `architecture/specs/02_data_model_postgres.md` for field semantics. |
| `extended_data` | JSONB per-unit extras from ingest. |
| `created_at` | Column from live Postgres; see `src/atoms_vs_ashes/db/models.py` and `architecture/specs/02_data_model_postgres.md` for field semantics. |

| BF-01 | Grid Capacity Basic Filter | basic_filter | screening |  |  | EPRI coal-to-nuclear criteria | Checks whether site grid capacity (installed or grid-connected MW) can accommodate one or more reference SMR designs. | BF-02 | Land Area Basic Filter | basic_filter | screening |  | IAEA NS-R-3 Rev.1, SSG-35 Annex II | EPRI coal-to-nuclear criteria A15 | Checks whether the site&#x27;s available land area (from OSM plant boundary measurement) can accommodate one or more reference SMR designs.
